name: Manager downloads the receipt PDF and reverses the receipt
title: SC-09-04-02 Manager downloads the receipt PDF and reverses the receipt
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a settled payment with an issued receipt
When the site manager downloads the receipt PDF and reverses the receipt
Then the PDF is delivered and the receipt is marked as reversed
